about: Business Technology and Digital Transformation professional with 7+ years of experience bridging business needs and technology across telecommunications and the public sector. My background combines IT Project Management, Business Analysis, Full-Stack Development, Business Process Management, and Business Intelligence. I have led 20+ technology initiatives, coordinated cross-functional teams, designed and developed enterprise applications, and delivered digital solutions supporting 24 departments and 500+ users. My experience spans the full solution lifecycle—from process analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design to development, testing, implementation, training, and continuous improvement. I am passionate about turning complex business challenges into practical, scalable solutions that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, reduce risk, and enable data-driven decision-making.
